summary.bn: আলো পড়লে বিদ্যুৎ দেয়: খোলা অবস্থায় প্রায় ৭ ভোল্ট, পুরো রোদে প্রায় ১ A। আলো যত কম, কারেন্ট তত কম।
summary.en: Makes electricity in light: about 7 V with nothing connected and about 1 A in full sun. Less light, less current.

simplified: Its curve is a light current of 1.1 A in full sun beside a string of solar cells, built to give 7.2 V with nothing connected (as DFRobot gives for its 5 V 1 A panel). The 1.1 A, the cells' figures and the 0.3 Ω in series are estimates.
The light slider runs from dark to full sun (about 1000 W/m²). Heat, the angle of the sun and shade on part of the panel are not modelled.
Its two wires go to the breadboard; the panel itself is drawn small.
